arxiv-1606-09380.title: C ​ P CP violation for B c + → D ( s ) + ​ π + ​ π − B^{+}_{c}\rightarrow D_{(s)}^{+}\pi^{+}\pi^{-} in Perturbative QCD
arxiv-1606-09380.creator: Gang Lü, Sheng-Tao Li, Yu-Ting Wang
arxiv-1606-09380.description: Abstract In the perturbative QCD (PQCD) approach we study the direct C ​ P CP violation in B c + → D ( s ) + ​ ρ 0 ​ ( ω ) → D ( s ) + ​ π + ​ π − B^{+}_{c}\rightarrow D_{(s)}^{+}\rho^{0}(\omega)\rightarrow D_{(s)}^{+}\pi^{+}\pi^{-} via the ρ − ω \rho-\omega mixing mechanism.

arxiv-2011-12325.title: Z ​ H ZH production in gluon fusion: two-loop amplitudes with full top quark mass dependence Preprint: . ZU-TH 45/20 . CERN-TH-2020-199 . IPPP/20/57 . P3H-20-076 . KA-TP-21-2020 . TTK-20-42 . PSI-PR-20-21
arxiv-2011-12325.creator: Long Chen, Gudrun Heinrich, Stephen P. Jones, Matthias Kerner, Jonas Klappert, Johannes Schlenk
arxiv-2011-12325.description: Abstract We present results for the two-loop helicity amplitudes entering the NLO QCD corrections to the production of a Higgs boson in association with a Z Z -boson in gluon fusion. The two-loop integrals, involving massive top quarks, are calculated numerically.

arxiv-2102-04631.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Peijun Li, Xiaohua Yao, Yue Zhao. In this paper, we study for the first time the stability of the inverse source problem for the biharmonic operator with a compactly supported potential in ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3} . Firstly, to connect the boundary data with the unknown source, we shall consider an eigenvalue problem for the bi-Schr o ¨ \ddot{\rm o} dinger operator Δ 2 + V ⁡ ( x ) \Delta^{2}+V(x) on a ball which contains the support of the potential V V .

arxiv-2104-03441.title: An investigation into the approximations used in wave packet molecular dynamics for the study of warm dense matter
arxiv-2104-03441.creator: William A. Angermeier, Thomas G. White
arxiv-2104-03441.description: Abstract Wave packet molecular dynamics (WPMD) has recently received a lot of attention as a computationally fast tool to study dynamical processes in warm dense matter beyond the Born-Oppenheimer approximation. These techniques, typically, employ many approximations to achieve computational efficiency while implementing semi-empirical scaling parameters to retain accuracy.

arxiv-2211-10497.title: Efficient quantum implementation of 2+1 U(1) lattice gauge theories with Gauss law constraints
arxiv-2211-10497.creator: Christopher Kane, Dorota M. Grabowska, Benjamin Nachman, Christian W. Bauer
arxiv-2211-10497.description: Abstract The study of real-time evolution of lattice quantum field theories using classical computers is known to scale exponentially with the number of lattice sites. Due to a fundamentally different computational strategy, quantum computers hold the promise of allowing for detailed studies of these dynamics from first principles.

arxiv-2302-12667.title: Deep active learning for nonlinear system identification Journal: Arxiv
arxiv-2302-12667.creator: Erlend Torje Berg Lundby, Adil Rasheed, Ivar Johan Halvorsen, Dirk Reinhardt, Sebastien Gros, Jan Tommy Gravdahl
arxiv-2302-12667.description: Abstract The exploding research interest for neural networks in modeling nonlinear dynamical systems is largely explained by the networks’ capacity to model complex input-output relations directly from data. However, they typically need vast training data before they can be put to any good use.

arxiv-2305-11034.title: Trading Syntax Trees for Wordpieces: Target-oriented Opinion Words Extraction with Wordpieces and Aspect Enhancement
arxiv-2305-11034.creator: Samuel Mensah, Kai Sun, Nikolaos Aletras
arxiv-2305-11034.description: Abstract State-of-the-art target-oriented opinion word extraction (TOWE) models typically use BERT-based text encoders that operate on the word level, along with graph convolutional networks (GCNs) that incorporate syntactic information extracted from syntax trees. These methods achieve limited gains with GCNs and have difficulty using BERT wordpieces.

arxiv-2309-03103.title: ContrastWSD: Enhancing Metaphor Detection with Word Sense Disambiguation Following the Metaphor Identification Procedure
arxiv-2309-03103.description: Abstract This paper presents ContrastWSD, a RoBERTa-based metaphor detection model that integrates the Metaphor Identification Procedure (MIP) and Word Sense Disambiguation (WSD) to extract and contrast the contextual meaning with the basic meaning of a word to determine whether it is used metaphorically in a sentence.

arxiv-2401-03816.title: CREATING PERSONALIZED SYNTHETIC VOICES FROM ARTICULATION IMPAIRED SPEECH USING AUGMENTED RECONSTRUCTION LOSS
arxiv-2401-03816.creator: Yusheng Tian, Jingyu Li, Tan Lee
arxiv-2401-03816.description: Abstract This research is about the creation of personalized synthetic voices for head and neck cancer survivors. It is focused particularly on tongue cancer patients whose speech might exhibit severe articulation impairment. Our goal is to restore normal articulation in the synthesized speech, while maximally preserving the target speaker’s individuality in terms of both the voice timbre and speaking style.

arxiv-2402-14631.title: Equidistribution for Random Polynomials and Systems of Random Holomorphic Sections
arxiv-2402-14631.creator: Ozan Günyüz
arxiv-2402-14631.description: Abstract . This article addresses an equidistribution problem concerning the zeros of systems of random holomorphic sections of positive line bundles on compact Kähler manifolds and random polynomials on ℂ m \mathbb{C}^{m} in the setting of the weighted pluripotential theory.

arxiv-2406-04656.title: The Active Optics System on the Vera C. Rubin Observatory: Optimal Control of Degeneracy Among the Large Number of Degrees of Freedom
arxiv-2406-04656.creator: Guillem Megias Homar, Steven M. Kahn, Joshua M. Meyers, John Franklin Crenshaw, Sandrine Thomas
arxiv-2406-04656.description: Abstract The Vera C. Rubin Observatory is a unique facility for survey astronomy that will soon be commissioned and begin operations. Crucial to many of its scientific goals is the achievement of sustained high image quality, limited only by the seeing at the site.

arxiv-2407-04091.title: Silkscreen : Direct Measurements of Galaxy Distances from Survey Image Cutouts Facilities: Blanco (DECam),Subaru (HSC)
arxiv-2407-04091.creator: Tim B. Miller, Imad Pasha, Ava Polzin, Pieter van Dokkum
arxiv-2407-04091.description: Abstract With upcoming wide field surveys from the ground and space the number of known dwarf galaxies at ≲ 25 \lesssim 25 Mpc is expected to dramatically increase. Insight into their nature and analyses of these systems’ intrinsic properties will rely on reliable distance estimates.

arxiv-2509-15331.title: Modeling the JWST MIRI Counts, Insights Into the Source Properties and Role of Dust-Obscured AGN Facilities: The research reported in this paper was done on the Tufts University High Performance Computing Cluster (https://it.tufts.edu/high-performance-computing) . Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et
arxiv-2509-15331.creator: Edgar Perez Vidal, Anna Sajina, Amber Rose Banks, Matthieu Béthermin, Carl Ferkinhoff, Andrea Petric, Alexandra Pope, Jianwei Lyu, Vivian U, L. Y. Aaron Yung, Pallavi Patil
arxiv-2509-15331.description: Abstract Understanding the co-evolution of galaxies and active galactic nuclei (AGN) requires accurate modeling of dust-obscured systems. Recent surveys using the Mid Infrared Instrument (MIRI) onboard the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) have uncovered a large population of dust obscured AGN, challenging current theoretical frameworks. We present an updated version of the Simulated Infrared Extragalactic Dusty Sky (SIDES) simulation framework.

arxiv-2601-21832.title: Goal-Driven Adaptive Sampling Strategies for Machine Learning Models Predicting Fields Journal: Aerospace Science and Technology
arxiv-2601-21832.creator: Jigar Parekh, Philipp Bekemeyer
arxiv-2601-21832.description: Abstract Machine learning models are widely regarded as a way forward to tackle multi-query challenges that arise once expensive black-box simulations such as computational fluid dynamics are investigated. However, ensuring the desired level of accuracy for a certain task at minimal computational cost, e.g. as few black-box samples as possible, remains a challenges.

arxiv-2603-14940.creator: Amos Alwala, Yuchen Hu, Gabriel da Silva Lima, Wallace Moreira Bessa

pmc-10608771.title: Possible Applications for a Biodegradable Magnesium Membrane in Alveolar Ridge Augmentation–Retrospective Case Report with Two Years of Follow-Up
pmc-10608771.creator: Daniel Palkovics, Patrick Rider, Svenja Rogge, Željka Perić Kačarević, Peter Windisch, Fabrizio Bambini, Roberto Rossi, Andrea Grassi
pmc-10608771.description: Background and Objectives: A rigid, resorbable magnesium membrane was recently developed, combining the advantages of resorbable and non-resorbable membranes. Our aim was to describe the application of this membrane for guided bone regeneration (GBR). Materials and Methods: This case report described the treatment and 3D evaluation of two cases utilizing a resorbable magnesium barrier membrane.

pmc-10750636.title: Predicting the Potential Complications of Lateral Column Lengthening: A Cadaveric Biomechanical Study
pmc-10750636.creator: Mingjie Zhu, Moustafa A. Maher, Todd Baldini, Carson Keeter, Kenneth Hunt, Mark Myerson, Shuyuan Li
pmc-10750636.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Category:Hindfoot; OtherIntroduction/ Purpose:Lateral column lengthening calcaneus osteotomy is a common procedure used to treat flatfoot deformity. However, the incidence of subtalar joint impingement and sinus tarsi pain presents a concern related to this treatment. The hypothesis of this study was with opening of the osteotomy, the anterior fragment of the calcaneus anterior process moves anteriorly, while the posterior fragment simultaneously moves posteriorly which can compromise the outcome as well as cause subtalar joint impingement.

pmc-11414034.title: Clinical significance of intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT) to the distant metastatic lymph nodes for metastatic cervical cancer
pmc-11414034.creator: Chi Fang, Suping Liu, Jie Xia, Xiaohua Wu, Jun Zhu, Guihao Ke
pmc-11414034.description: ObjectiveTo retrospectively explore the clinical significance of radiotherapy to the distant metastatic lymph nodes (cervical/ clavicular/ mediastinal et al.) in metastatic cervical cancer. Hereinto, these cervicothoracic lymph nodes were metastasized from IB1-IVA (initial stage at first treatment), and IVB initially had metastatic disease in these areas at diagnosis.

pmc-11430296.title: The Effect of Social Information Processing, Self-Regulation and Metacognition on Theory of Mind: Path Analysis †
pmc-11430296.creator: Canan Keleş Ertürk, Kezban Tepeli, Haruhiro Higashida
pmc-11430296.description: Objectives: The main purpose of the current study was to examine the effects of social information processing, self-regulation, and metacognition variables on ToM using path analysis. Methods: For this purpose, path analysis was conducted for the model established according to the relationships between the variables.

pmc-11585710.title: A novel adjunctive diagnostic method for bone cancer: Osteosarcoma cell segmentation based on Twin Swin Transformer with multi-scale feature fusion
pmc-11585710.creator: Tingxi Wen, Binbin Tong, Yuqing Fu, Yunfeng Li, Mengde Ling, Xinwen Chen
pmc-11585710.description: Highlights•Proposed a Twin Swin Transformer based on Swin Transformer, achieving efficient osteosarcoma cell segmentation with multi-scale feature fusion.•Replaced the original Swin block with the Twin Swin Transformer block to enhance feature interactions across stages.•Added channel attention mechanism, improving segmentation accuracy.•Extracted detailed morphological and spatial information, aiding in personalized treatment strategies.

pmc-11603450.title: Non-combustible nicotine product cessation interventions in adolescents and young adults: A systematic review
pmc-11603450.creator: Sofie K Bergman Rasmussen, Charlotta Pisinger
pmc-11603450.description: New nicotine products such as e-cigarettes, heated tobacco and smokeless tobacco/nicotine products, are popular among young people. Most regret having started using these products, but little is known about how to help adolescents and young adults to quit most effectively.

pmc-11665876.title: Modeling the within-host dynamics of Plasmodium vivax hypnozoite activation: An analysis of the SPf66 vaccine trial
pmc-11665876.creator: Somya Mehra, François Nosten, Christine Luxemburger, Nicholas J. White, James A. Watson
pmc-11665876.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). SignificancePlasmodium vivax is the main cause of human malaria outside Africa. Relapse, caused by the activation of dormant liver hypnozoites, is a major cause of symptomatic illness and transmission. Little is known about the mechanisms of hypnozoite activation. We calibrate a simple mathematical model of relapse, which assumes random constant-rate activation of individual hypnozoites, to longitudinal data from the most detailed cohort study ever conducted in an area co-endemic for both vivax and falciparum malaria.

pmc-12463978.title: “Everybody wants to coach it, but fewer know how to do it”: a qualitative study of stakeholders’ perspectives on mental skill development in youth sports
pmc-12463978.creator: Philippe O. Müller, Ulrike Schwarzer, Dave Collins, Renato Frey, Jörg Spörri
pmc-12463978.description: Background/objectivesIn recent years, the role of psychological training in youth sports has received increasing attention in both research and practice. The development of mental skills is important for sporting excellence, as it improves performance and helps athletes grow in their personality.

pmc-12466245.title: SilhouetteScoreinR: Beyond traditional network layouts by leveraging local cohesion and nearest neighbor separation
pmc-12466245.creator: Hua-Ying Chuang, Willy Chou
pmc-12466245.description: The silhouette score (SS) quantifies how well each entity fits its assigned cluster by contrasting within‐cluster cohesion with nearest other–cluster separation. Although common in other fields, SS is rarely used in bibliometrics. Using 2,252 MethodsX articles (2020–2024), we show how SS evaluates clustering quality in co-word networks and author collaborations, independent of the chosen algorithm.

pmc-12605741.title: Peptides: powerful, pervasive, and full of potential
pmc-12605741.creator: Alyssa Kearly
pmc-12605741.description: Small peptides are a diverse and biologically integral group of biomolecules that, due to their organic nature and multitude of functions, are poised to be attractive targets for commercialization and bioengineering in a world that must grapple with changes in climate and societal needs.

pmc-12615601.title: A glucose kinase-independent HK2 activity prevents TNF-induced cell death by phosphorylating RIPK1
pmc-12615601.creator: Tianhao Zou, Ran Liu, Gengqiao Wang, Guoliang Wang, Zhengting Jiang, Chuanzheng Wang, Weimin Wang, Mao Cai, Shuhua Zhang, Huan Cao, Di Zhang, Xueling Wang, Shenghe Deng, Tongxi Li, Jinyang Gu
pmc-12615601.description: Tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-induced RIPK1-mediated cell death is implicated in various human diseases. However, the mechanisms RIPK1-mediated cell death is regulated by metabolic processes remain unclear. Here, we identify hexokinase 2 (HK2), a critical regulator of glycolysis, as a suppressor of TNF-induced RIPK1 kinase-dependent cell death through its non-metabolic function.

pmc-12854158.title: In vitro physicochemical characterization of nephropathogenic strain of infectious bronchitis virus isolated from poultry
pmc-12854158.creator: Kamran Saaed, Faisal Ayub, Muhammad Arshad Durrani, Abdul Rafay, Mobashra Mustafa, Irtaqa Gull, Zahra Rafi, Muhammad Kashan Ansari, Muhammad Mubashar Beig, Abdul Razak, Hafiz Muhammad Moavia Atique
pmc-12854158.description: Infectious bronchitis virus (IBV) is an important pathogen in the poultry industry causing avian infectious bronchitis that is, an acute but highly contagious disease affecting the upper respiratory tract, kidneys and reproductive tract. The 3rd passage of a polymerase chain reaction confirmed nephropathogenic IBV isolate was used for this study.

pmc-12966930.title: APOE ε4 and Accelerated Cognitive Decline Among Cognitively Healthy Middle-Aged and Older Adults
pmc-12966930.creator: Yu-Chu Ella Chung, Ren-Hua Chung, Chih-Cheng Hsu, Yu-Li Liu, Rai-Hua Lai, Wen-Jiu Hung, Ray-Chin Wu, Yun-Jin Jiang, Shao-Yuan Chuang, Shih Feng Tsai, Cheng-Chin Kuo, Chao Agnes Hsiung, Wei J. Chen
pmc-12966930.description: Key PointsQuestionIs APOE ε4 carrier status associated with accelerated cognitive decline in cognitively healthy adults in Taiwan, and does an APOE-excluded polygenic risk score estimate risk of similar decline?FindingsIn this cohort study of 4392 adults aged 55 years and older, APOE ε4 carriers—especially homozygotes—showed accelerated decline in Mini-Mental State Examination scores, diverging from noncarriers after age 70 years.

pmc-13274137.title: Seeing is believing: visualizing spatiotemporal lipophagic flux in vivo with the tfLiveDrop reporter mice
pmc-13274137.creator: Siqiao Gong, Chen Yang, Huafeng Liu

pmc-13482314.title: Longitudinal Evaluation of Chromatic Pupillometry and Retinal Thickness in Dogs With Sudden Acquired Retinal Degeneration Syndrome
pmc-13482314.creator: Soohyun Kim, Ann E Cooper, David J Maggs, Ariana D Marangakis, Tran Nguyen, Monica Motta, Sara M Thomasy
pmc-13482314.description: ObjectiveTo determine longitudinal changes in chromatic pupillary light reflexes (cPLR) and retinal layers in dogs with sudden acquired retinal degeneration syndrome (SARDS).Animals StudiedClinical evaluation: Fifteen SARDS‐affected and nine control dogs. Histology: Achieved globes from five SARDS‐affected (1–7 years post‐diagnosis) and eight age‐matched controls.ProceduresDogs underwent ophthalmic examination and electroretinography to confirm SARDS.
